description: Fetch the people who reacted to a single LinkedIn post. Costs 5 credits per call. Engagers (with reaction kind) are persisted to the post_engagements graph so subsequent queries about who-engages-with-whom are SQL, not API calls.

refresh.description: Bypass the cache and re-fetch from LinkedIn (costs 5 credits). Default false: a previously-fetched result is returned free, with how long ago it was retrieved.

name: linkedin_post_reactions
title: LinkedIn Post Reactions
